skills.name: Holy Water Flask
skills.text: Throw a flask of holy water within {range} tiles: it bursts for {dmg} Holy Fire damage to foes within {radius} tile, {unholyPct}% more against Unholy foes.

variants.name: Blessed Font
variants.text: The water pools where it lands for {turns} turns. Standing in it heals you {healPct}% of your max Life each turn.

variants.name: Acid Censure
variants.text: The water is laced with acid: it deals Blight damage, and foes hit lose {armourCut}% armour for {turns} turns.

variants.name: Sprinkle
variants.text: Sprinkle the water through a {coneTiles}-tile cone in front of you instead of throwing it.

skills.name: Alchemist's Bandolier
skills.text: Your belt holds one more draught from rank 1, and your draughts are {draughtPct}% stronger.

skills.name: Firebomb
skills.text: Throw a firebomb within {range} tiles: {dmg} Fire damage to foes within {radius} tile, and the ground there burns for {burnTurns} turns.

variants.name: Cluster
variants.text: The bomb splits into {bombs} smaller bombs that land around the target, each dealing {bombPct}% of its damage.

variants.name: Sticky
variants.text: Foes hit are set Burning for {stickyTurns} turns.

variants.name: Pitch Pot
variants.text: The burning ground spreads {burnRadius} tiles from the impact.

skills.name: Smoke Censer
skills.text: Swing a smoke censer at a cell within {range} tiles: a cloud of radius {radius} hangs there for {turns} turns. Foes inside lose {accuracyCut}% accuracy, and while you are inside you are hidden.

variants.name: Incense
variants.text: Unholy foes inside take {dot} Holy Fire damage each turn.

variants.name: Choking
variants.text: Foes inside take {dot} Blight damage each turn.

skills.name: Torchlight
skills.text: Sweep a torch's flame through a {range}-tile cone, dealing {dmg} Fire damage to every foe in it.

variants.name: Interrogate
variants.text: Foes in the flame are Feared for {fearTurns} turns.

variants.name: Purge
variants.text: The flame burns away the helpful effects on every foe it touches.

variants.name: Searing
variants.text: Foes in the flame are Vulnerable for {turns} turns.

skills.name: Purifier
skills.text: Your Fire damage rises by {firePct}%, and you gain {critPct}% critical chance against Burning foes.

skills.name: Auto-da-fé
skills.text: Raise a burning stake within {range} tiles for {turns} turns. Each turn it pulses for {pulse} Fire damage to foes within {radius} tiles, and foes slain near it explode for {burst} Fire damage to those beside them.

variants.name: Penitents' Pyre
variants.text: Each turn the stake drags foes within its reach {pull} tile toward it.

variants.name: Ashes
variants.text: When the stake burns out it leaves a Smoke Censer cloud behind.

skills.name: Volatile Mixtures
skills.text: Your bomb skills have a {bombCdSkipPct}% chance not to start their cooldown.

strings.tree.desc: Purge the wicked with holy water, fire and smoke, and raise the stake for the worst of them.
strings.zone.blessed_font.name: Blessed Font
strings.zone.blessed_font.desc: A pool of holy water. It heals the Witch Hunter who stands in it.
strings.zone.censer_smoke.name: Censer Smoke
strings.zone.censer_smoke.desc: Thick, sweet smoke. Those within it see poorly, and a Witch Hunter inside it is hidden.
strings.stake.name: Burning Stake
strings.stake.desc: A stake wreathed in fire, raised for the condemned. It scorches everything around it for {turns} more turns.
strings.buff.acid_censure.name: Acid Censure
strings.buff.acid_censure.desc: Acid has eaten into this creature's armour: it has {pct}% less for {turns} more turns.
strings.buff.censer_haze.desc: Smoke stings this creature's eyes: its attacks are {pct}% less accurate while it stays in the cloud.
strings.buff.sticky_pitch.name: Clinging Pitch
strings.buff.sticky_pitch.desc: Burning pitch clings to this creature and keeps it alight for {turns} more turns.
strings.buff.purifier.name: Purifying Flame
strings.buff.purifier.desc: The Witch Hunter's fire burns hotter.
strings.refuse.stake_cell: The stake cannot be raised there.
